steps.code:
# Search for each song and find the exact match
# We'll search with title and first artist, then filter by exact title and all artists
found_songs = []
for song in songs:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Build query: title + first artist (or all artists joined)
    query = title + " " + artists[0]
    # Search with page_limit=20 to get more results
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find exact match: title matches and all artists match
    match = None
    for r in results:
        if r['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artists
            result_artists = [a['name'] for a in r['artists']]
            # Check if all required artists are present (order may vary)
            if all(any(ra.lower() == art.lower() for ra in result_artists) for art in artists):
                match = r
                break
    if match:
        found_songs.append({'song_id': match['song_id'], 'title': title, 'artists': artists})
        print(f"Found: {title} -> song_id {match['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title} by {artists}")
        # Try searching with all artists
        query2 = title + " " + " ".join(artists)
        results2 = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query2, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
        for r in results2:
            if r['title'].lower() == title.lower():
                result_artists = [a['name'] for a in r['artists']]
                if all(any(ra.lower() == art.lower() for ra in result_artists) for art in artists):
                    match = r
                    break
        if match:
            found_songs.append({'song_id': match['song_id'], 'title': title, 'artists': artists})
            print(f"Found (retry): {title} -> song_id {match['song_id']}")
        else:
            print(f"Still not found: {title}")

print("\nTotal found:", len(found_songs))
